opening.argument: The offer is a stated $25 Best Buy gift-card contest with ordinary participation requirements: viewers must subscribe and submit a comment or video response explaining why they want the card or what they would do with it. These are engagement conditions typical of a giveaway, not a demand for payment or credentials. The description also expressly states, “I am not affiliated/sponsored by Best Buy in any way,” clarifying that the creator does not present the promotion as an official Best Buy offer. The described contest therefore provides a conventional promotional reward without the indicators of a deceptive transaction.
